sentences.en: The duty must be discharged by every one of you.
sentences.zh: 这个职责必须由你们每个人来履行。

sentences.en: The tannery used to discharge effluent straight into the river.
sentences.zh: 皮革厂过去常常直接把废水排入河里。

sentences.en: When the work was done, the men were discharged.
sentences.zh: 工作完成后，这些人被解雇了。

senses.zh: 获准离开，释放排放出的物体

mnemonic: 词根记忆：dis（分离）+charge（电荷）→分离出电荷→放电
